---
name: incident-workitem-creation
description: Create or update incident work items through GitHub MCP and Jira MCP using concise evidence-backed summaries.
---

# Incident Work-Item Creation

1. Build a record-ready incident summary from current evidence.
2. Include impact, timeline, status, owner, and next action.
3. Update existing GitHub MCP and Jira MCP work items without duplication.
4. Keep updates concise and operator-ready.
